$comment: 다음 방문 예정 — the soonest still-upcoming registration as a short human string (`8/15 토 · 12가1234`), or `—` when there is none. A string rather than a date because Homey has no date sensor and the useful glance is who and when, not an ISO value. **The date is deliberately short** (dates.format_kst_short, not format_kst_human): the full form ran to 26 characters, Homey truncated it from the right, and what disappeared was the plate — the half a user is scanning for. The year is what was dropped, and it carried nothing here since every date this can show is inside dates.MAX_DAYS_AHEAD; the register notification still uses the long form, where the year is the whole mitigation for a misparsed Flow date argument. TODAY COUNTS AS UPCOMING: a visit booked for this afternoon has not happened yet, and skipping to tomorrow at midnight would answer a question nobody asked. `insights: false` — graphing a label produces nothing, which is the same call iparking_park_name got before it was deleted.
